claim: The current ChatGPT Deep Research product still produces citation-bearing fullscreen reports and supports downloads in Markdown, Word, and PDF.
The ChatGPT model/mode surface has changed recently: OpenAI's June 2026 release notes use Pro Standard and Pro Extended labels, and GPT-5.2 ChatGPT conversations moved forward to GPT-5.5.

Agentify's ChatGPT Deep Research path is implemented and locally tested: it exposes an async MCP tool, activates Deep Research through UI controls, waits with research-specific long-running patterns, and exports Markdown reports.

Agentify is not fully up to date with current ChatGPT naming: selection can likely recognize Pro Extended because labels beginning with Pro map to extended-pro, but selectors, display labels, docs, and one thinking-banner regex still preserve older Extended Pro assumptions.

Community sentiment on ChatGPT/GPT Pro for deep research-style work is mixed: some users praise GPT-5.5/ChatGPT for broad exploration and thorough deep research reports, while others report confusing Pro limits, inconsistent quality, or prefer Claude for specific professional work.

Given reliable Extended Pro access, a full Deep Research automation rebuild is not the best use of effort; the worthwhile work is a small compatibility hardening pass plus a live smoke test if Agentify keeps exposing agentify_research.
